purpose: Measure deployment cost and the near-tied input-strategy alternative; these measurements do not change the frozen configuration or seed selection rules.
device: cuda on the same RTX 5060 Ti
filesystem_cache_policy: Read all test image files once immediately before each benchmark; do not clear system caches.
model_setup: Model loading/setup excluded from image-to-CSV timer; separate job sidecar reports process invocation wall time.
gpu_warmup: No explicit warm-up; first image included.
scope: Image read/decode, preprocessing, device transfer, inference, connected components, RLE encoding and exact round-trip checks, CSV writing/closing.
limitations: One pass per saved model on this computer is descriptive timing, not a repeated runtime estimate.
Different outputs require different connected-component/RLE work; the measurement intentionally covers the complete pipeline.
Test labels are unavailable; no test accuracy is inferred from these timing runs.
Canonical prediction-archive export has additional storage cost and is reported separately.
